model_details.name: Anchor Compact Lapse Predictor v1
model_details.architecture: Calibrated L2-Regularized Logistic Regression with Fold-Safe Preprocessing

intended_use.application: Supportive JITAI risk alerting for individuals in alcohol recovery
intended_use.intended_horizon: 24-hour lead time ahead of a rolling 7-day outcome window
intended_use.non_intended_use: Medical diagnosis, emergency care dispatch, or standalone clinical decision

ethical_and_safety_considerations.stigma_prevention: Never outputs 'relapse detected'; uses supportive tier labels ('Steady', 'Watchful', 'Higher Support')
ethical_and_safety_considerations.cold_start_warning: Returns 'calibrating' status if fewer than 72 hours of check-ins exist
ethical_and_safety_considerations.privacy: All signals are encrypted; zero clinical identifiers stored in model weights
